tenderSchedule.description: Providing Man Power service to APMC Sirsi (E-Trading) 2026-27

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Minimum five years (up to FY 2025-26) experience in deploying Manpower personnel to State Government Departments, State Government Undertakings. Certificates by competent authorities should be uploaded on the e-procurement portal in support of meeting this requirement

Disbursed Annual salary payments of not less than Rs. 15.00 lakhs to various categories of personnel in other offices as stated in (a) above in one or more contracts in any one of the last five years (2021-22 to 2025-26). This should be Certified by a Chartered Accountant and the certificate should be uploaded on the e-procurement porta1

The tenders should have executed at least two service contracts (copy of contract or certificate from concern organization/ institute may be furnished and uploaded) during the last five yearsi.e.2021-22 to 2025-26., to similar organizations as detailed in (a) aboveCertificates by competent authorities should be uploaded on the e-procurement portal in support of meeting this requirement
Tenderer has to submit the Returns of ESI, PF and GST / Service Tax, Professional Tax in the recent past three years without fail
The tenderer has to submit Latest valid Form-C issued by the labor department with atleast 10times of the tender manpower as the staff working in his/her organization.
The tenderer has to submit Last Three years paid receipts of labour welfare fund paid to the welfare commissioner Karnataka labour welfare board(FORM-D) to be submitted
The tenderer should comply with the minimum wages as per the zones specified by Department of Labour.
The Tenderer must have been ISO 9001-2015, ISO 27001-2013 & ISO 20000-1&2018 certified for providing Manpower services.
The Tenderer should have paid ESI & EPF Payment within the Stipulated Due time. Tenderer Should provide ESI & EPF Payment Challans from 2021-22 to 2025-26
The Tenderer must have made profit during the past 3 Financial Years. Supporting financial of the organization should be uploaded on the e-procurement portal
Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account of the Tenderer for the three years (2023-24 to 2025-26) duly certified by a Chartered Accountant.
Annual Turnover Statement for the five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26) should not be under Rs. 15.00 lakhs and should be duly certified by Chartered Accountant.
Declaration for Nonblack listing of the firm anywhere in India.
